_README: Determinations that exist ONLY inside embedded images, transcribed by reading the
PNGs that `python -m pipeline.pdfimages` writes to cache/images/.
pdftotext sees nothing in these documents, so without this file the pipeline reports
a confident wrong answer (e.g. zero related-party spend for ACC-7802 and ACC-7806).
Every entry records its source document so it can be re-checked against the image.
On event day: re-run `python -m pipeline.pdfimages`, LOOK at the PNGs, and update this.
Values here are used only where the text layer yields nothing for that account.
